DRAFT sample. Ask early, ask both ways, and keep it warm. Most families say yes when they see you are sharing the same papers yourselves.

## When should you ask?

Before the roka is a good time. Feelings are still light, and nobody has spent money on the wedding yet.

## What should you say?

Keep it short and kind. Say that your family will share the same documents, and that you ask this of every family you meet.

:::composite
A mother in Lucknow sends a short WhatsApp message to the other family. She offers her son's papers first and asks for the same in return. The reply comes the next day, with thanks.
:::

## What if they refuse?

A refusal is not proof of anything. Ask once more, gently, and listen to the reason before you decide.
